environment: Ubuntu WSL2 on Windows; other benchmark and GUI workloads overlapped, so timings are observations rather than isolated speed estimates
samtools_adapter: Only --version output is reduced to its first line to avoid an invalid-UTF8 compiler banner in PS2. All actual samtools operations call /usr/bin/samtools unchanged.
batch_deferred_reason: 10-primer full-length verification required about five minutes per mode and batch RSS was higher. Stop larger runs under the requested computation budget; no completed 100/500 real-genome results are claimed.
evidence_limits: In-silico tool concordance, timing and sampled process-tree RSS only. No Wet validation; tool disagreements have not been biologically adjudicated. The 10-primer hash compares priming sites and metadata, not a separately measured pair-level amplicon panel.
